allow_any_root.description: Whether to allow TLS with non-CA-signed certificates

allow_expired_certs.description: Whether to allow TLS with expired certificates

digest_options.description: HTTP Digest auth option(s); e.g., 'DenyMD5' or ''

server_name.description: CUPS server address (hostname:port), IP:port, or socket path

trust_on_first_use.description: Whether to auto-trust new TLS certificates on first connect

validate_certs.description: Whether to enforce CN matches server hostname
